characteristics.name: Modifer
characteristics.$text: Friendly Regiments currently within 12" of the Archangel count their Divine Purpose Special Rule as active regardless of whether the Regiment has been the Target of a Theist Priest's Spell or not.

rules.name: Aspect of the Avenger
rules.description:
The Archangel gains access to the following Action.
Flames of Vengeance (Out-of-Combat Action): The Archangel immediately performs a Charge Action, with a Charge Distance of 16" ignoring the effects of Hindering Terrain. Should this Charge be completed successfully the Archangel automatically cause 8 Hits with the Smite Special Rule against the Target Enemy Regiment. If the Charge Target is an Objective Marker, it is immediately destroyed. This Action must be performed as the Regiment's first Action. Once the Action is performed the Regiment's Activation immediately ends.

rules.name: Aspect of the Redeemer
rules.description: At the end of the Archangel's Activation all Theist Infantry Regiments currently within 8" of the Archangel gain the Regeneration (X) Draw Event until the end of their next Activation where X is half the number of successful Hits caused to an Enemy Regiment (to a maximum of 5) by the Archangel during its Activation (rounded down). In addition the Archangel gains the Shield Special Rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Select 1 Spell from a different School to be cast once per game as an Action.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Attacks directed at the Regiment bearing this banner never count as Inspired.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Household Guard Stands in the Character's Regiment have +1 Clash.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character Stand gains this Draw Event: Immediately perform a free Reform Action with the Character Stand’s Regiment. The Character Stand then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character, and all Stands in its Regiment, have +1 Resolve (to a maximum of 5) and the Fearsome special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemy Stands in contact with the Character lose the Cleave and Smite special rules while in contact with the Character.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character Stand gains +1 Wound and +1 Defense.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character re-rolls Defence Rolls of 6

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character Stand gains the Barrage 3 (24”, Deadly Shot) Special Rule. If the Character Stand already has the Barrage Rule it receives an additional +3 to its Barrage value and the Deadly Shot Special Rule. Range remains unaffected.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character re-rolls failed To Hit Rolls and opponents must re-roll successful Injury Rolls in a Duel.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character re-rolls failed To Hit Rolls when making Impact Hits and gains Brutal Impact (2).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character re-rolls failed To Hit Rolls when performing a Clash against a Stand of Monsters.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character re-rolls failed To Hit Rolls when performing a Clash against a Stand of Brutes.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the following Supremacy Ability : Until end of Turn, all friendly Regiments within 6" have +1 Volley.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per game, the Character Stand counts as a Spellcaster for purposes of “Enemy Interference”. Enemies within 8” cast spells with three less dice rather than the usual one.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the Fearless special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The first time the Character's Stand (not the Character's Regiment, unless they are one and the same) suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a score of 2+, the Wound is Healed.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the following Supremacy Ability: Until end of Turn, this Stand has the Smite special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per game, when the Character Stand would be reduced to 0 Wounds or less, it is returned to the battlefield with 1 Wound remaining at the end of that Activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the Seize the Day Draw Event.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
Until End of Turn, if the caster’s Regiment is declared as the target of an enemy Regiment’s Charge Action 
the charging Regiment gains the Decay 2 Draw Event until the end of its activation

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the caster’s next activation, all Stands in the caster’s Regiment count as Obscured when targeted by a ranged attack. If the Regiment already counts as Obscured against the declared Attack, they also gain +1 Defence against that Volley Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: If the Target unit wishes to declare a Charge or March Action, it may only do so as its First Action. If it takes a Charge or March Action as its First Action, it may not take a Second Move Action that Turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: All Stands in the caster’s Regiment have +1 Resolve until End of the caster’s next Activation.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Inflicts one Hit per success. Hits have the Armor Piercing 2 special rule.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When the caster’s Regiment takes a Volley Action this Turn, its shots are not Obscured by range, so long as within the maximum range of the weapon.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Until the caster’s next activation, the caster’s Regiment may re-roll all rolls of ‘6’ when rolling to hit with a Volley Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: For each success, the caster’s Regiment Heals two Wounds.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: For the turn this Supremacy Ability was used you may re-arrange all Command Cards in your Command Stack.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Every Regiment in the Priory Commander’s Warband gain “Blessed” for this Turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Warlord’s current Regiment (and the Warlord himself ) gain the ‘Fury’ Draw Event and can re-roll failed Impact Hits. This Supremacy ability is always considered to be active.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All your Regiments immediately lose their ‘Broken’ status and gain Devout for the Turn (except for your Priory Commanders and their Warbands). In addition, for the remainder of this Turn your Regiments cannot become ‘Broken’

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The caster's Stand gains the Cleave 2 and Deadly Blades Special Rules until End of Turn, and may immediately perform a Duel Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Remove any Broken status from the Target, exactly as if it had used a Rally Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: All Stands in the caster’s Regiment gain the Blessed special rule until End of Turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: All Stands in the caster’s Regiment have +1 Defence or +1 Evasion until End of Turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Servite is alive, the Regiment has +1 March and +1 to Resolve.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Neophyte is alive, the Regiment has the Devout special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Knight of the Shield is alive, the Regiment’s Clash Actions always count as Inspired. In addition, any Character in the Regiment has +1 Attack while fighting a Duel Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: While both an Armsmaster and a Noble are alive in the Regiment, the Clash characteristic of the Regiment is increased by +1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Count Palatine is alive, the Regiment’s Clash Actions always count as Inspired.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Drillmaster is alive, the Regiment has the Fury Draw Event.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When an enemy Wizard attempts to cast a spell within 8” of a Null Mage, any of the Spellcasting dice rolled that do not come up as a success inflict a Wound on the Caster. These Wounds cannot be mitigated or saved in any way but do not trigger Morale Tests.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Veteran is alive, the Regiment has the Bastion Draw Event.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While the Tourney Champion is alive, the Regiment adds 2 to its Charge distances.
